newsitem.title: USA: Anergen sees future quarterly losses.
newsitem.headline: Anergen sees future quarterly losses.

text.p: Anergen Inc said on Friday that "near-term future quarterly losses are expected to be more consistent with losses in previous quarters."
The biotechnology company made the statement in reporting narrower losses for the third quarter and nine months of $0.01 and $0.22 a share, respectively.
The company said it completed a follow-on public offering during the quarter that generated gross proceeds of about $11 million.
In the 1996 second quarter the company lost $0.12 a share. In the 1996 first quarter it lost $0.10 a share.
